title: Northbeam TechWorks Contract Credit Note: Relief Recognised on a Business Invoice
content:
The relief recognised against the charges a business invoice settlement covers on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the grounds the write-offs standing on the job were granted on.

**Where a write-off granted on a term of the customer's business contract stands on the job**, every write-off standing on the job is recognised.

**Where the only write-offs standing on the job were granted on the plan's cover**, those plan write-offs are recognised.

**Where neither situation holds**, no relief is recognised against those charges.

## The grounds side by side

| Write-offs standing on the job | Relief recognised |
| --- | --- |
| at least one on a term of the business contract | every write-off standing on the job, whatever ground each rests on |
| all of them on the plan's cover, none on a contract term | those plan write-offs |
| some on other grounds, none on a contract term and not all on the plan's cover | nothing |
| none at all | nothing |

The second reading is a strict one: the plan write-offs are recognised only where they are the whole of what stands on the job. A plan write-off standing beside a goodwill write-off, with none on a contract term, falls into the third line and nothing is recognised.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**Plan cover alone.** A hypothetical job carries 73.20 USD written off on the plan's cover and nothing else. The second reading governs, and 73.20 USD is recognised.

**A plan write-off beside a goodwill write-off.** The same job also carries 26.40 USD as goodwill, with none on a contract term. The third reading governs: nothing is recognised.

**A contract write-off standing too.** The job carries 132.60 USD written off on a term of the business contract alongside the 73.20 USD on the plan's cover. The first reading governs, and 205.80 USD is recognised.
